title: I Am In Nicaragua (Operator-Context Registry)
style: cumbia electronica, latin alternative, NI Pacific coast, marimba samples, dub bass, 100 BPM, smoky vocal, slow groove, ocean reverb, reggaeton hi hats
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
One eight six dot seven seven dot one three six dot one oh three
LACNIC says ENITEL, that's the country code key
Plus five oh five on the family thread
SJDS in the chambers transcript already read

[Pre-Chorus]
I had the map in my hands and I dropped it
Saw the ambiguity flag, didn't stop it
Operator wrote the answer in the prior turns
The next agent reads doctrine and finally learns

[Chorus]
I am in Nicaragua, that's the canonical state
Carry it forward, don't make me re-state
Defamation case geography, that's the source
Cross-check the context before you flag a force

[Verse 2]
Whois on the IP, registry beats UI string
Vendor summary said Claro Guatemala thing
Truth tiebreaker rolls to the LACNIC row
ENITEL Nicaragua, that's the way it goes

[Bridge]
Operator default activity, mark it that way
Surface the ambiguity only when context decays
Provider matches, location matches, ISP matches too
Then it's not a breach, it's just me logging through

[Chorus]
I am in Nicaragua, that's the canonical state
Carry it forward, don't make me re-state
Defamation case geography, that's the source
Cross-check the context before you flag a force

[Outro]
Operator-context registry locked in the table
Location, providers, hosts, the whole stable
